title: Boar meat

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
Boar meat is a basic food obtained by killing Boars.
It can be cooked on a Cooking station or Iron cooking station to obtain Cooked boar meat, or Coal if overcooked.

sections.heading: Crafting
sections.text: Cooked boar meat cannot be used to craft recipes using Boar meat as ingredient, or vice versa.

full_text:
Boar meat

Type: Material | Internal ID: RawMeat | Source: Boar | Usage: Crafting | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

Introduction. Boar meat is a basic food obtained by killing Boars.
It can be cooked on a Cooking station or Iron cooking station to obtain Cooked boar meat, or Coal if overcooked.

Crafting. Cooked boar meat cannot be used to craft recipes using Boar meat as ingredient, or vice versa.
